description: T-slot nut (DIN 508): a prism with an inverted-T cross-section (wide base under the slot lips, narrower neck through the slot opening) and a central vertical bore. Slot width pairs with a thread size (DIN 508 catalog row) and the neck is the DIN 508 slot-fit width B1 = slot - 0.4; base/height/length are proportion. A lead-in chamfer appears on the hard tier. The central bore carries a modelled internal metric thread: drilled to the minor diameter, with a helical V-groove of the ISO coarse pitch cut out to the major diameter.
source: norelem 07060 (nuts for T-slots, DIN 508) for the (slot -> thread) pairing and B1 = a - 0.4 (both DIN 508); base/neck-height, base width and length declared as proportion
